drk.text: Maeveen O'Donagh's troop hides pikes in the grass to face a cavalry charge, but he is made to stand helpless as his whole troop is killed.
He saves Yunnie as he is about to jump from Merfolk Vista, and the group travels north with him to Urhaalan Valley, where Yunnie's adopted minotaur tribe is at war with the elves.
Peemel tasks Maeveen and Vervamon with finding the Sigil of Iwset, and the quest reveals Yunnie to hold the sigil, so Maeveen's group helps defeat Sacumon and end the war at great cost.
Maeveen brings Yunnie to Iwset, resulting in the deaths of Peemel and Digody.
